purpose: Canonical end-of-migration cleanup backlog. Partial ports retain original coverage until replacement evidence or reviewed retirement resolves each gap.

gaps.missing_proof: Real settings API 409 SettingsConflict translation; original manufactures a repository.StaleSettingsError with a private save patch.
gaps.cleanup_action: Find a deterministic real request/revision conflict that exercises the translation, or explicitly review retirement/reclassification of the private-injection oracle.

gaps.missing_proof: Abrupt process-death recovery during import, after import and after source rename. New real SQLite/filesystem exception fixtures prove retry behavior but are not equivalent crash proof.
gaps.cleanup_action: Establish real process-death observations at meaningful durable boundaries without private strategy substitution, or review the intended guarantee and disposition.

gaps.missing_proof: Whether root cleanup via dot/dot-slash is intended product behavior. The evaluation contract required rejection, but that contract was not a historical product specification.
gaps.cleanup_action: Resolve product intent, then add the accepted regression behavior and any required fix. Do not promote the evaluation requirement or discard the observed discrepancy implicitly.

gaps.missing_proof: The new plugin declares no hard-hang timeout or descendant-process cleanup guarantee; old runner protections must not disappear silently at cutover.
gaps.cleanup_action: Implement/test supported timeout and process-tree policy or explicitly accept a changed guarantee before removing the old execution path.

gaps.missing_proof: Original max_active_writes==1 assertion required patching the replacement function. New real concurrent operations establish successful statuses and no lost updates, not an observed non-overlap interval.
gaps.cleanup_action: Establish stable application-owned mutation interval/lock observations or a supported deterministic synchronization boundary; alternatively review whether internal serialization is required beyond atomic final outcomes.

gaps.missing_proof: Original child edit waits during an active directory move depends on pausing os.replace via a patch. Sequential real move and stale-path rejection do not prove active contention/waiting.
gaps.cleanup_action: Exercise real concurrent move/edit with stable lifecycle/lock observations or a sanctioned controllable I/O boundary, without claiming sequential results prove waiting.
